positions.title: Honors Object-Oriented Design and Data Structures TA
positions.description:
Plan content and presentation of laboratory material for 1-hour laboratory sessions each week with 15-20 students

Design and write two programming assignments as well as collaborate with other course staff to develop a staff implementation of the final project

Grade all exams, and student programming assignments

Hold 1-2 office hours each week

positions.title: CIT Student Team Lead
positions.description:
Hire, organize, schedule, and train student staff
Provide support for IT Services at Cornell University
Work to ensure the best possible customer service for students, faculty, and staff
Monitor performance of Cornell's IT infrastructure

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff, Intern
positions.description:
Added flexibility to scoping a data-intensive summary report, built data aggregators to restructure archived usage data for faster queries

Analyzed and tuned queries and parameters for scripts controlling syncing existing database objects between machines

Prototyped a daemon service to greatly improve the performance of syncing newly added database objects across machines.

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Refactored existing single-process system, which loads compressed data files onto the 1010data system, into a master process which saves state and allows restart in the event of a signal or crash, and slave process which tips, segments, and writes data onto several machines.

positions.title: Command and Data Handling Co-Lead
positions.description:
Designed and currently developing a CDH Application to interface with satellite sensors and handle all ground communications

Utilizing Goddard's Core Flight Executive to develop and test an application in C running in VxWorks for Control Moment Gyroscopes

Developed Python scripts to help build a hardware emulator as well as a command utility to more easily send test commands over UDP.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Built an extensible, class-based view system for actions in custom, versioned CMS for Django

Helped refactor an existing deployment system to use a context processor and easily deploy configuration files directly onto production servers using Fabric. 

Using Django, helped develop the back-end for several projects on both MySQL and PostgreSQL databases
